profile.name: Braden M Clark
profile.headline: Associate Technical Professional in Systems Engineering at KBR inc. • BS in Electrical Engineering from Cedarville University
profile.about: My name is Braden Clark and I am an electrical engineer. I desire to obtain a career in the fields of robotics, signal processing, or aerospace design to increase my knowledge of applied electrical and computer engineering.

experience.title: Digital Signal Processing Engineer
experience.description: Development of hardware and software products in support of defense and aerospace contracts. Key Skills: Software defined radios, Programming in Python and MatLab, Digital signal processing.

experience.title: Engineering Intern
experience.description: Completed an independent project involving ADS-B aircraft tracking. Gained skills in signal processing with software-defined radios.

experience.title: Engineering Intern
experience.description: Worked with the R&D department to design solutions to specific problems such as optimization of machine cycle time and designing utilities throughout the shop. Researched and installed new variable frequency drives on the CNC machines. The solution reduced cycle time and saved the company money. Configured and ran 5-axis CNC mills, lathes, and CNC tig welding machinery.

projects.title: SAR Image Processing
projects.description: Developes a more-image-than-memory SAR image processing and viewing system using Python and SarPy

projects.title: ADS-B Aircraft Tracking
projects.description: Developed a real-time aircraft tracking gimbal that uses ADS-B signals to track aircraft and capture images.

projects.title: ML Based Lift Truck Pallet Detection
projects.description: Deveolped lightweight CNN classifier that could monitor the productivity of a lift truck operator through the presence/absence of pallets on the lift truck.
